info.title: toktokdata.live API
info.description: TikTok LIVE intelligence over HTTPS: official rankings, creators, recorded LIVE sessions, alerts and exports. Authenticate with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`); each operation needs the scope it lists. Reads are billed in credits from the workspace wallet. Responses carry a `provenance` object that says how complete and how fresh the data is, whether it is TikTok's own number (`sourceKind: official`) or toktokdata.live's (`derived`), and the time window it covers.

get.description: The stored public profile and its recent history of counters. A creator not stored yet (or stored long ago) is looked up on TikTok: when that takes longer than a few seconds the answer is `202` with `status: resolving`, a `jobId` and `retryAfterSeconds` (also `Retry-After`); ask again then and the profile is there. `status: saturated` (202) means too many lookups are running; a handle TikTok does not know is a `404` and is not looked up again for ten minutes; `503 resolve_unavailable` means TikTok could not be read right now.

post.description: Builds a dataset: `live_sessions` (the followed sessions in the range), `rankings` (one official board as your plan sees it, masked rows stay masked; needs `rank:read`), `gifters` (the gifters of the recorded rooms, `rangeDays` up to 7 for 7 days else 30, optional `region`; needs `gifter:read` and the Pro plan), `watchlist` or `recruit_pipeline` (the recruit marks, from the Pro plan; both signed-in sessions only). Up to 1,000 rows the job comes back `ready` (201); above that it is `pending` (202) and is built in the background: poll it until `ready`. Every file carries its provenance: CSV rows end with `source`, `observed_at`, `coverage_status` and `methodology`, a workbook adds a `Provenance` sheet. Charged only when an API key creates it.

get.description: The file itself (`text/csv` or Excel), as an attachment. `409` until it is ready.

Who gifts in the LIVE rooms toktokdata.live recorded over the last 7 or 30 days, by diamonds: gift count, sessions, creators gifted, the creator of the last room and the previous window's diamonds. Each gifter has a segment: `whale` (at least 10,000 diamonds in 7 days or 30,000 in 30 days), `rising` (at least 1,000 diamonds and twice the previous window), `regular` (3 sessions or more), `one_time` (one session) or `occasional`. `region` keeps gifts to creators of that region. Coverage is always `partial`. Needs the Pro plan or above.

get.description: The latest chat comments of the creator's LIVE room, oldest first, for a chat panel next to the player. Poll it every few seconds and pass the previous answer's `cursor` as `after` to get only newer comments (at most 100 per answer; when more arrived, the newest 100). Comments exist only for rooms toktokdata.live follows and that your workspace follows (watchlist or room subscription): `status: tracked` with `roomId`, otherwise `status: not_tracked` with no items (`followed` says whether your workspace follows the creator). toktokdata.live keeps the last 200 comments of a room for 10 minutes after the last one. Free (no credits), limited to 60 requests a minute per user (429 with `Retry-After` beyond that).

parameters.description: `cursor` of the previous answer: only newer comments.

get.description: The signed, expiring video URL of the creator's current LIVE room. Your player loads it directly from TikTok's CDN (`source: tiktok-cdn`); toktokdata.live never proxies the video. `hlsUrl` is preferred; `flvUrl` is the source of FLV-only rooms (play it with an MSE engine such as mpegts.js); at least one is set on `status: live`, and `expiresAt` is when that URL stops working. `renditions` is often empty. `avatarUrl`, `followerCount` and `region` are null when unknown. Other answers: `status: offline` (not live), `status: no_playback` (live, but TikTok exposes no playable source), 202 `status: resolving` (poll the same URL after `Retry-After`), 503 `collection_saturated` or `live_playback_upstream_unavailable` (retry), and 503 `live_playback_not_configured` while the feature is off on this deployment (do not retry). Needs the `live:stream` scope, not `live:read`.

get.summary: Get a masked row's LIVE totals

get.description: One board for one region, as TikTok publishes it. Boards are reproduced only after coverage passes a gate: read `publishable` and `coverage` before showing entries. Entries beyond what the plan unmasks keep `rank` and `score` but come back with `masked: true`, no identity (`creatorUid`, `avatarUrl` and `roomId` are null) and the `unmaskTier` that reveals them; `maskedRef` reads their LIVE totals through `/v1/rankings/masked/{ref}`. A masked entry also has null `movement`, `previousRank` and `sparkline`, which would tell where it sat before. On the current period every other entry carries `sparkline`: its score in each of the last seven complete periods, oldest first, `null` where it was not on the board.

Provenance.description: How fresh and how complete the data is, and where it comes from. `observedAt` is when the data was observed, never when it was served: it is `null` (with `coverageStatus: not-covered`) when nothing was observed yet. Treat a missing number as unknown, not as 0.
